description: Second year of secondary English (2ème année de l'enseignement secondaire, tronc commun — the same Student's Book serves all four sections): eleven themes from Perform to Learn — family life and the image of who you are, friendship and communicating by e-mail and text, travel and social life, social problems, attitudes and values, rights and duties, education, professional life and the career project, media and the arts, science and technology, and ecology — working the present perfect and the present perfect progressive, the passive voice, reported speech, question tags, causative verbs, used to, perfect modals of regret and advice, quantifiers, adverbs of degree and cause/result linkers through reading, listening, speaking and writing
